verdict.rationale: Gecko documents API keys with named scopes, GitHub App 'scoped, auto-rotating access' and GitLab token rotation (docs-11, docs-25, docs-26, docs-12), which nominally support least-privilege credential issuance for connected tools/agents. However, community hands-on reports concretely contradict the least-privilege claim: the GitHub OAuth flow requests broad 'act on my behalf' and profile/email write permissions rather than fine-grained scopes, prompting explicit user pushback (comm-1, comm-7). Missing for 10: documented per-agent scope configuration, evidence that API keys/tokens can be restricted to specific actions/resources, and resolution of the OAuth over-permissioning complaint.
